title: PdrQC: Pauli-space Discriminative Representations based Quantum Classifier
summary: Quantum classification faces two key challenges. First, the difficulty of distinguishing between different classes varies: some class pairs are easy to separate, while others are more challenging. Second, practical execution is affected by noise, finite sampling, and measurement overhead. To address these issues, we propose the Pauli-Space Discriminative-Representation based Quantum Classifier (PdrQC), a framework for task-adaptive multiclass quantum classification.
